# Lindsay Morton

> Brand, demand generation and go-to-market leader with about 15 years in marketing, building ideas that deserve to spread. Based in the Birmingham, Alabama area.

This is Lindsay Morton's personal site: a playful, interactive résumé and portfolio. Visitors fall down a vortex and step through three doors (Career, Games and Ventures) to see her work, the games she makes for her sons, and her art.

## About Lindsay
- Studied journalism; about 15 years in marketing.
- Started at one of the first social-media-only agencies (SocialKaty), working with Chicago tech startups and bringing in her own clients.
- Co-founded Techli, a tech publication.
- Marketing roles include 3dcart, Vivun and Klaar. At Klaar she rebranded the company and launched its AI within one month.
- Wants to work with companies and people doing good in the world.
- Believes the brands, people and ideas that cut through the noise are whimsical, memorable and unique.

## Work and projects
- Pollinate: her current venture, helping ideas that deserve to spread.
- The Sanctuary: an invite-only AI work, life and organization app.
- 52 Saturdays: an inspiration book with one intentional adventure for every Saturday.
- The Coven: an invite-only marketplace for energy healers, tarot readers, herbalists and makers, by and for women.
- Draper Real Estate: brand and website for a Houston Heights realtor.

## Games (made for her sons)
- Van's Cove: her redesign of Treasure Cove, her favorite computer game growing up, made for her son Van.
- Brick Shop, Wildkind and Kiko's Pond: learning and play games for kids.
